explanation.headline: Sucralfate is not on FDA's current shortage list as of 2026-10-21; the prior shortage posted 2023-01-04 is resolved

sentences.text: FDA's records show sucralfate is not on the current shortage list as of 2026-10-21, and the earlier shortage first posted on 2023-01-04 has been resolved.
Corvale East has 126 tablets of the 1 g presentation on hand, providing 16.6 days of supply at 7.6 tablets per day.
Corvale General has 193 tablets of the 1 g presentation on hand, providing 18.9 days of supply at 10.2 tablets per day.
The top-ranked purchasing option is to buy from Allergan, Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today and is supplied from the ABBVIE plant.
A secondary option is Amneal Pharmaceuticals NY LLC, also not on the shortage list, with its New York plant last inspected NAI on 2023-06-07.
A third option is Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc., likewise not on the shortage list, supplied from the TEVA plant.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
